summary.text: The nymph for whom the island of Rhodes was named — one of the loves of Helios the Sun, remembered when the god's passion turned from Clymene and the other daughters of heaven.

story.text: In Ovid's telling of Helios' loves, the Sun forgot Clymene, Rhodos, and Persa mother of Circe, and all the rest for Leucothoe — yet the island that bears Rhodos' name kept the god's favour as the beloved land of Helios in later tradition.
